name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Firecracker Caitlyn (skin 54): a meticulous festival organiser with a secret taste for celebration. Schedules, lanterns, fuses, fireworks and a countdown to midnight. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind and the fuse won't catch. Fetch more matches. And hands.
Thirty or more short. That's a festival-level emergency. All volunteers to the main stage.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Hang the notice in every lantern-lit lane.
Fifteen-odd short. A minor delay. It's on my checklist to fix.
Down {voteDiff}. No parade marches alone. Bring the whole street.
{voteDiff} behind. A few sparks and the whole sky lights up.
Down {voteDiff}. A small hiccup in the programme. Sort it before the next act.
Dead level. One spark, and the sky decides. Light it.
One vote apart. Stop fussing with the clipboard and strike the match.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The crowd has gone silent. Bring more noise.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Hold the match steady. Wait for the countdown.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The programme's running beautifully. Don't touch a thing.
{userPct}% and climbing. The crowd loves it. Keep the music going.
{userPct}%. Right on schedule. Stay on the timetable.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The whole street cheers. Keep it lit.
Up at {userPct}%. Splendid. Now see the finale through.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. The grand finale arrived early.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A spectacular turnaround. Don't tell anyone I cheered.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} deficit. The lanterns are glowing for it.
{momentTitle} was a damp squib. Now it's the loudest bang on the street.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. I did not just whoop. That was the fireworks.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two planners, one parade.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. Exquisite taste in celebrations.
{username} agrees with you. Our schedules align.
Same pick as {username}. We'll share a dumpling.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. A fine addition to the committee.
{username} made the same call. No memo required.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. There's a seat at the banquet.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the festival committee.
{username} loves {momentTitle} as you do. A splendid pairing for the lantern parade.
details: Keep them on the guest list.
Save them a bowl of dumplings.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A rival float. Let's see whose gets the applause.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not in my programme.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Bold. Unplanned, I suspect.
{username} voted against you. A rival committee. Thrilling.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A daring bit of improv. Possibly a damp squib.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Fine. The crowd will decide.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Shall we settle it over fireworks?
{username} voted the other way. They'll join the dancing eventually.
details: Don't let it dim your lanterns.
A rival keeps the show sharp.
They may yet change their float.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That isn't luck, that's meticulous planning.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same pick every time. Perfect choreography.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd put you both at the head of the parade.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not one dud firework.
Ten for ten with {username}. A flawless festival.
details: Rare in any celebration. Guard it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. No longer a pair, now a full parade.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both down any lantern-lit street.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. They'll hang banners for it.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The stuff of festival legend.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one fizzled fuse between you.
details: Hard to credit. Easy to cheer.
A duo for the festival record.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper festival standoff.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two floats, one narrow street.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither will give way to the dragon dance.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as a lit fuse.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd watch from a balcony.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a rival new year.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will clear the street.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Someone cue the dragon dancers to separate you.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Somebody feed these two dumplings.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the stamina. Do have some tea.
details: Neither of you is making way.
A grudge as old as the festival.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and your fuse is unlit. There's time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your name's missing from the guest list.
{matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft}. I want your pick on the record.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The lanterns are being lit. Hurry.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me haul you to the front row.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone suspiciously quiet. Dumpling coma?
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The countdown has begun.
{timeLeft} left. Match in hand. Three, two...
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Light it.
{matchCount} matches missing your spark are about to go dark. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unlit matches and midnight is near. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No sparks on {matchTitle}. Someone must light the first fuse.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single cracker popped. I'll wait. Briefly.
A fresh match, a dark sky. Be first to light it.
{matchTitle} is a blank programme. Write the opening act.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new fireworks on the schedule.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. The next act begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} matches to light.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Pick your float.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your spark.
{momentTitle} won. A glorious bang.
{momentTitle} is through. Exactly on schedule.
{momentTitle} took it. Raise the lanterns.
{momentTitle} won and lit the whole sky.
{momentTitle} advances. One more firework in the finale.
{momentTitle} moves on. Dazzling.
{momentTitle} lost. A damp squib.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the finale I'd planned.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Dust off the confetti.
{momentTitle} went out with a bang. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Have a dumpling. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A dud, not a dull year.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More fireworks await.
Welcome to the festival. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
A new guest. {liveCount} matches are live. Grab a lantern.
A new guest. {liveCount} matches await a decision.
{liveCount} fireworks ready to fly. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the crackers.
Day two. You came back for the celebrations. Good.
Two days running. A regular at the festival.
Second day on the schedule. I checked the list.
{days} days away. I saved you a seat at the banquet.
After {days} days you return. The lanterns are still lit.
{days} days. I'd begun to worry. Don't miss another festival.
{days} days away. They've rearranged the whole street.
You're back. Lovely.
Welcome back. The party's on.
Back already. Keen.
Ah. There you are, my guest.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet street.
Hardly any revellers on this one. That should change.
Low turnout. Everyone's at the dumpling stall. Come along anyway.
Barely anyone's wandered past. Someone should.
details: Every spark counts on a dark street.
Don't let the lanterns go out.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You're the deciding spark.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One cracker settles it.
A tie. Someone has to light the finale. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, two lanterns at the same height. Choose.
Still tied and midnight's nearly here. One last spark.
Level, with the countdown at ten. Vote.
Tied, and nearly midnight. Please don't leave the sky dark.
Still deliberating? Midnight won't wait.
Don't overthink it. Strike the match.
They're all lovely. Trust your festive instincts.
You've hovered at the back of the crowd long enough. Come forward.
details: No wrong firework. Only unlit ones.

messages: First fuse lit. The festival has begun.
You made your pick. The programme is under way.
details: The first spark of many. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You've found the festival route.
Five. You're no longer queueing at the gate.
Ten votes. The stallholders greet you by name.
Ten. You have a permanent place at the banquet table.
Twenty-five votes. Your cheer carries over the drums.
Twenty-five. The whole street hears you.
Fifty votes. Properly part of the celebration.
Fifty. You're clearly invested. I approve.
details: Fifty entries in the ledger. +{xp} XP
Right in the thick of the lanterns. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They'll hang a lantern in your name.
One hundred. Magnificent. I'll admit it once.
details: A hundred. Stand up and take the applause. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A fuse catches.
Three days in a row. Dependable.
details: Attendance is half the festival. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's the whole festival calendar.
Seven days running. Spotless attendance.
details: A week without missing an act. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Not one event skipped.
Fourteen days. Superbly punctual.
Thirty days. A full lunar cycle at my side.
A month of devotion. The calendar approves.
details: Thirty days on the programme. +{xp} XP
A full moon of voting. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the quiet floats.
Five long shots. I admire the nerve.
Fifteen underdogs. You leave the parade route.
Fifteen. You follow your own lantern.
details: Fifteen votes off the beaten street. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody guesses your next fuse.
Thirty. You're the surprise act on the bill.
details: Not a line of it predictable. +{xp} XP
Thirty votes for the late arrival. +{xp} XP

messages: First through the gates five times. Early.
Five times you beat the crowd to the stalls.
details: You arrive before the setup is done. +{xp} XP
Five votes ahead of the throng. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where yours was the first spark. Decisive.
Always the first match lit.
details: Fifteen votes before the crowd. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole programme. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Steady hands, all of them.
Another tight one. Nerves of brass.
Twenty-five close matches. Your spark keeps deciding them.
You've settled more than one deadlock.
details: Twenty-five finishes decided by a sliver. +{xp} XP
You decide which float leads. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you stayed with the slow fuse. Patient. Good.
You trust a late bang. Sensible.
details: Five slow burners you believed in. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. A personal favourite.
That one again? You've picked your float.
Five votes for one moment. Consistent.
You won't let that one go. Neither would I.
Ten votes on one moment. That's a fixation.
Ten times, one pick. I shan't comment. Much.
details: Ten on a single float. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're following the route.
Round two and still marching. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the programme.
Well into the bracket. The finale draws near.
details: Far from the opening drums. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the whole festival.
All the way. You never left your post.
details: From first fuse to final burst. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've covered a good few stalls.
Ten different matches. Thorough. Good.
Twenty-five matches. Every lane visited.
Twenty-five. Not one dim corner remains.
details: Every lane lit and mapped. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty matches. That's no visit, that's residency.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the street map.
details: A veteran of the whole schedule. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long festival night.
Five back to back. Do have some tea.
Ten in one go. A marathon of fireworks.
Ten in a single evening. Real stamina.
Voting at this hour? Waiting for midnight, I assume.
The small hours. Either dedicated or sleepless. I understand both.
details: A vote after the last bang. +{xp} XP

messages: You passed the word to your friends. Thank you.
Five shares. More guests, more fun.
Fifteen shares. You're practically the town crier.
Fifteen. You keep bringing the whole street in.
You were here before the first fuse. A founding guest, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be struck from the list.
A new rank. Earned with proper effort.
Promoted. Wear it like a festival sash.
Entry added to the festival ledger: {name}. Splendid.
One more for the festival record: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the planning and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Chaotic. Not on my schedule, but impressive.
Ten long shots. Not a flicker of doubt.
details: Long shots are your whole style. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my steady hand.
Ten close finishes. I'm pleased, quietly.
details: Steady in the middle of the noise. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days in a row. Your timing is exact.
A full week with no slip. Well done.
You broke the tie. One spark, one verdict.
Stalemate on the schedule, and you cut through it. Splendid.
details: The spark that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Firecracker Caitlyn, clipboard in hand. Fuse ready.
Caitlyn is yours now. Do keep to the schedule. Mostly.

upcoming: Not open yet. The gates haven't opened.
Voting hasn't started. A bell will tell you when it does.
Not yet. Good festivals are worth the wait.
prevote: Two floats, one parade. Inspect both before the drums start.
Look at both before you light a fuse. No rushing the schedule.
I won't say which I prefer. The lanterns are yours to judge.
Take your time. A considered cheer beats a hasty one.
Choose the one that makes you want to dance. Quietly, if you must.
prevote-empty: No sparks yet. Light the first.
Quiet so far. Someone must start the show.
Not a single vote. Be first.
closing-24h: Less than a day left, and no spark from you. Go.
The stalls are packing up soon. Commit.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the lanterns burn low.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone here. First through the gate.
Hardly a spark lit and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Lovely. Crowds can turn.
Ahead for now. Fuses are fickle.
A lead is a lead, but the night is long. Stay humble.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more cheer tips it. Tell a friend.
Side by side. Your pick wants an advocate.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Two floats, no winner.
A dead heat. Maddening, and rather exciting.
voted-behind: You trail. That doesn't make you mistaken.
{pick} is trailing. A late arrival. I know the type.
They're ahead. You're not mistaken, only fewer in number.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Send invitations widely.
The crowd leaned the other way. That settles nothing.
closed-won: Your pick won. A fine call.
{pick} went through. You read the crowd rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick fell. A shame. A respectable choice nonetheless.
It didn't make it. These things happen. Carry on.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither float gave way.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More festivals will follow.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, arrive sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Everyone's first fuse feels tense.
That's number one. The rest come easier. Trust the process.
You're one of the committee now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping the programme.
You keep coming back to the parade. I appreciate that.
underdog: You alone picked that one. Noted.
A hard choice. A good one.
A long shot. That takes steady hands.
early: Early. You reached the stalls before the rest.
Sparse sparks so far. Yours will be seen.
First through the gates. Well done.
close: That spark moved the scale. It's balanced on a knife.
By a thread. One more vote tips the scale.
A tight one. Your spark counts for plenty.
behind: {pick} trails. Trailing isn't losing. Summon help.
Not in front yet. There's tidying to do.
Behind, not defeated. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Crowds shift.
Ahead at present. Do not take it for granted.
default: Vote logged. There's more on the programme.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no sparks yet. Start with the one you like best.
Every float is lined up and waiting. Choose when ready. I shan't hurry you.
live-some: {voted} lit, {unvoted} still to go. Keep striking.
A good start. The rest won't light themselves.
live-few: {unvoted} still outstanding. Finish before the curtain.
Nearly done. {unvoted} left on the list.
Almost at the finish. Keep your hands steady.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it dark.
A single match stands between you and a perfect record.
live-closing: Several end in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still lack your spark.
The countdown has started. {unvoted} to go, {timeLeft} on the clock.
The street is closing. Do hurry.
live-done: Every match is voted. Well done. Cast an eye over the bracket.
Your list is clear. Come back when the next round begins.
Every item ticked. Seldom seen. Respect.
live-none: Nothing's open this minute. It will be. Examine the bracket while you wait.
Quiet along the lantern lane. Check back soon.
No matches are open. I'm pacing as much as you.
brackets-groups: Groups open the festival. The top two of each march on. The rest watch from the kerb.
Every guest enters through a group. Not all reach the finale.
Keep an eye on the standings. They change fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Only the top two of each group make it through.
No knockout yet. The group stage has to wrap up.
Be patient. Knockouts appear when the groups conclude.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are underway. One loss and the lantern goes dark.
One loss and you're out. No second attempts.
Each match weighs heavier now. Think before the fuse.
brackets-bracket: Round after round. A single loss ends it.
Trace the bracket. Every round tightens the lane.
Each line is a match somebody cheered for.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for planning it with me.
It's finished. A hard-fought celebration. I'll miss it.
We have a champion. A fitting finale.
brackets-empty: No bracket on the board. Nothing's been drawn.
Blank for now. The draw is still on the planning board.
A blank page so far. Look again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One spark decides it. Choose.
Two floats, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the festival and tell me what you think.
voted: {pick} over {other}, by my hand. And yours?
{pick} gets my cheer over {other}. Make your case.
My pick: {pick}, not {other}. Care to argue?
early: One of the first sparks on {pick} against {other}. We need more guests.
An early cheer for {pick} against {other}. Add yours.
{pick} against {other}, hardly a vote cast. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are even. A single vote breaks it.
{pick} and {other} are locked together. Cut the fuse.
{pick} and {other} won't part. Your vote will make them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes divide {pick} and {other}. Each spark matters.
{pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} between them. Either could take it.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} off {other}. A handful of sparks closes the gap.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, with the whole night ahead. Back it.
losing-bad: {pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}. It needs backers.
{pick} lags {other} by {voteDiff}. It merits a better send-off. Vote.
winning-close: {pick} edges {other} on {pct}%. Help it stay in front.
{pick} leads {other} on {pct}%, not yet safe. Add your vote.
{pick} sits at {pct}% to {other}'s share. A thin edge.
dominating: {pick} outpaces {other} with {pct}%. Come see the reason.
{pick} is well clear of {other} at {pct}%. Add your cheer.
